visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A LinkedList Object Instead of Hand-Linked Nodes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Three node objects are created and linked by hand and the list is walked in the main code. Write a LinkedList with add and toArray. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The list hides the pointer handling behind two clear operations, so callers cannot link nodes wrongly, and adding a fourth value is one more call.
